newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANZ hopeful of second China license.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANZ hopeful of second China license.

text.p: Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said on Wednesday it expected its application for a second banking license in China to receive favourable consideration from the country's government.

"We have applied for - and we think our application will be favourably considered - a license for Beijing," chief executive officer Don Mercer told reporters after announcing the company's results for fiscal 1995/96.
The license, if granted, would give ANZ a major presence in the north of the country, complementing the bank's four-year-old branch in Shanghai, Mercer said.
"This is part of our building of the franchise for the future," he added.
The bank earlier reported a six-percent rise in net profit to A$1.12 billion for the year to September 30, 1996.
